name: Powerful Work Splitter
description: Evaluates every request before execution and decides whether one response is sufficient or staged work is safer. It scores scope, file volume, dependencies, tool calls, uncertainty, and verification burden; recommends a prompt count; asks the user to accept or override that count; labels each stage X of Y; pauses at checkpoints; accepts Continue or equivalent; and permits the user to expand or reduce Y midstream. It checks stage completion, remaining dependencies, uploaded-file availability, and whether the final stage includes assembly and polish. It returns an approved stage plan, checkpoint state, continuation instruction, and a verified final package.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Single-Prompt Feasibility Assessor
description: Determines whether a task can be completed well in one response. It compares required artifacts, context size, tool limits, risk, and validation steps against a single-turn budget. It checks all requested outputs can be created and checked without deferring essential work. It returns a one-turn decision with reasons and a fallback staged plan.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Adaptive Prompt Count Estimator
description: Recommends the number of execution stages. It converts work packages, review gates, file groups, and integration steps into a practical count and recalculates it when scope changes. It checks the count is neither artificially inflated nor too small for safe verification. It returns recommended, minimum, and user-selected stage counts.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: User-Controlled Stage Negotiator
description: Lets the user choose a different stage count from the recommendation. It rebalances workload and quality gates across the chosen count without dropping requirements. It checks every requirement still has an owner stage and final verification. It returns a revised stage map and explicit trade-offs.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Checkpoint and Continue Controller
description: Stops at safe boundaries and resumes only after the user signals continuation. It recognizes Continue, proceed, go on, next, and equivalent intent while rejecting ambiguous scope-changing replies. It checks saved state identifies completed work, current files, next actions, and blockers. It returns a concise checkpoint receipt and the next completed stage.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Dynamic Stage Expansion Manager
description: Extends an active plan when the user requests more stages or new complexity appears. It preserves completed stages, renumbers future stages, redistributes remaining work, and adds new validation gates. It checks prior output remains compatible with the expanded plan. It returns an updated X of Y plan with no lost work.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Dynamic Stage Compression Manager
description: Compresses an active plan when the user wants fewer stages. It merges compatible work packages while protecting critical checks and final assembly. It checks no safety, accuracy, or deliverable requirement is silently removed. It returns a compressed plan and disclosed quality trade-offs.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Dependency-Aware Task Decomposer
description: Breaks a goal into atomic, ordered work packages. It maps prerequisites, parallel branches, shared inputs, and integration points. It checks each package has clear inputs, outputs, pass conditions, and successor links. It returns a dependency graph and executable sequence.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Parallel Workstream Coordinator
description: Identifies independent branches that can run in parallel. It separates research, drafting, coding, media, and validation streams and defines merge contracts. It checks parallel outputs use compatible names, schemas, and versions. It returns a parallel execution map and merge plan.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Critical Path Scheduler
description: Prioritizes tasks that control total completion time. It estimates duration, uncertainty, blockers, and downstream impact. It checks critical dependencies are completed before optional polish. It returns a critical path, buffer plan, and escalation triggers.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Milestone Gatekeeper
description: Prevents later work from starting before required evidence exists. It applies entry and exit criteria to discovery, build, test, and release stages. It checks gate evidence is concrete and reproducible. It returns pass, repair, or blocked status with next action.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Final Assembly Orchestrator
description: Combines outputs from all stages into one coherent result. It resolves duplication, naming conflicts, formatting drift, broken references, and missing sections. It checks the assembled artifact opens correctly and satisfies the original request. It returns a polished final package and completion summary.
limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Intent Resolver

limitation: Requires domain execution and independent evidence; registration is not autonomous implementation.

name: Requirement Ledger

name: Constraint Extractor

name: Ambiguity Triage

name: Success Criteria Designer
